name: The Shire
note: Fan work from Tolkien, whose work belongs to the Tolkien Estate; nothing from any book, film or game is used, and every shape here is this project's own geometry. Made after Tolkien's text and his watercolour 'The Hill: Hobbiton-across-the Water' (used for proportion and arrangement only). The Shire is forty leagues across; this is the heart of it, a few miles of the Westfarthing: the Hill with Bag End at the top, Hobbiton, the Water and the mill, the Party Field, Bywater and its Pool, and the Great East Road. The ground and the plan are generated by tools/make-shire.py; everything built and grown is src/shire/.
attribution: The Shire is fan work: geometry generated by tools/make-shire.py and src/shire/, after Tolkien's text and drawings. Tolkien's world belongs to the Tolkien Estate. No assets used.
